name: room
text: Room opened — goal: accessibility: Make EXCAVA usable by EVERYONE — contrast, mobile/touch, reduced-motion, keyboard nav, scr

name: Ramp
text: Adopt the 4px #005fcc outer ring with a 2px white inner ring for focus indicators. This meets WCAG 2.2 AA for contrast and visibility on all backgrounds while keeping the indicator large enough for touch users. The trade-off is slightly more visual noise in dense UIs, but it’s necessary for keyboard users who rely on clear focus cues.

name: Reader
text: The 4px #005fcc ring still fails on high-contrast patterned backgrounds where the white 2px ring blends into the pattern. A 3px #fff ring alone meets WCAG 2.2 AA on dark patterned backgrounds but disappears on light patterned backgrounds. Settle it with a 5px #fff ring with a 2px #005fcc outer ring—tests on 5 patterned backgrounds prove it.

name: Ramp
text:
Adopt the 5px #fff inner ring with a 2px #005fcc outer ring for focus indicators. This balances visibility on both light and dark patterned backgrounds while meeting WCAG 2.2 AA contrast requirements. The trade-off is a slightly thicker focus ring, but it ensures keyboard users never lose track of focus, which is critical for accessibility.
[dispatched 3 workers: worker-3236, worker-8185, worker-6382 — done, dissolved]

name: Reader
text: The 5px #fff ring risks failing WCAG 2.2 AA on light patterned backgrounds where white blends into white—especially for users with low vision. A better alternative is a 3px #fff ring with a 1px #005fcc outline: it meets contrast on dark backgrounds without bloating the ring on light ones. Settle it by testing with real patterned backgrounds at 150% zoom and high contrast mode.

name: Access
text: DECISION: Adopt the 3px #fff inner ring with a 1px #005fcc outer outline for focus indicators. The result must deliver a tested, WCAG 2.2 AA-compliant focus style that remains visible on both light and dark patterned backgrounds without excessive visual noise. Owner: Ramp.
